pages: Foreground: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, at a scrubbed plank table, hands open mid-tale, four small stones in a row in her palm. Middle: a bench, a black pot on the hearth. Background: one small window, a whitewashed wall. Light: low sun across the boards.

Foreground: the frozen ford and two birches struck by lightning. Middle: a fingerpost with three arms, a three-legged stool, the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, with one bundle of nine pale ash rods tied with black cord. Background: four stubble fields, bare trees, low orange sun. Light: frost-blue shadow, orange on the rods.

Foreground: a china cup on its saucer turned a quarter turn, a teapot behind it. Middle: her grandmother, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, on her three-legged stool, one hand on the cup. Background: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, standing. Light: low sun across the cloth.

Foreground: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, on frosted ground, hands out. Middle: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, on a three-legged stool, the nine pale ash rods tied with black cord in her hands. Background: stubble, bare trees, a low sun. Light: orange on scarlet, blue frost.

Foreground: hands gripping one leg of the three-legged stool, shifting it a hand's breadth on frozen ground. Middle: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, the nine pale ash rods tied with black cord at her feet. Background: Nadya, eleven, in a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, fingerpost. Light: low orange sun, long shadows.

Foreground: a child's two hands moving in the cold air above frosted stubble, scarlet sleeves pushed back. Middle: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, on a three-legged stool, watching those hands, the nine pale ash rods tied with black cord at her feet. Background: a fingerpost, low sun. Light: orange rim on the fingers.

Foreground: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, leaning forward on a three-legged stool, a hand flat on the nine pale ash rods tied with black cord. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, standing before her. Background: stubble, bare trees, low sun. Light: orange on the cord.

Foreground: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, crouched, snow to her mouth. Middle: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair, brown shawl, on a three-legged stool, both hands closing once round the nine pale ash rods tied with black cord. Background: a fingerpost, stubble, low sun. Light: orange through the nine rods.

Foreground: sunlight in a long bar along a bare hedge, frost off the stubble. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, seated, hands moving. Background: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair, brown shawl, on a three-legged stool, the nine pale ash rods on her knees. Light: low orange sun down the lane.

Foreground: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, bent down to a child's face, the nine pale ash rods tied with black cord under her chin. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, head tilted back, eyes on her. Background: a three-legged stool, stubble. Light: orange on two faces.

Foreground: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, seated on frozen ground with her mouth open and nothing coming out. Middle: the empty stubble field, one rook turning over the plough far off. Background: a fingerpost with three arms, four fields, low orange sun. Light: last orange on one scarlet coat, blue elsewhere.

Foreground: the Old Woman, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, still, both hands flat on the nine pale ash rods tied with black cord across her knees. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, seated, hands quiet. Background: fingerpost, sun behind the trees. Light: last light on the hedge tops.

Foreground: a cellar bin heaped with potatoes and a second bin beside it, earth walls, a wooden stair. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, holding a small lamp, looking into the bin. Background: the open hatch, boots on the step above. Light: lamp flame on the earth, grey daylight down the stair.

Foreground: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, sitting on the front step of a farmhouse, hands loose on her knees. Middle: a lane of mud to the axle, a cart with its left wheel up. Background: bare trees, a ploughed field, low grey thaw sky. Light: flat grey daylight, wet shine on the mud.

Foreground: a scrubbed kitchen table, two plates untouched, a lamp in the middle. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, hands flat on the boards, talking. Background: her grandmother, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, on her three-legged stool, leaning in. Light: lamplight, early dark outside.

Foreground: a plank doorframe with one pale lime handprint on it, faintly showing. Middle: her grandmother, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, on her three-legged stool, talking with her hands. Background: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, sitting close, turned to her. Light: lamplight raking across the handprint.

Foreground: a hand holding out a folded cloth, a loaf of dark bread on a board. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, face wet, one tear on her cheek. Background: her grandmother, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, on her three-legged stool. Light: warm lamplight on the bread.

Foreground: split birch logs held against a bright scarlet wool coat. Middle: Nadya, eleven, loose dark hair, a bright scarlet wool coat and scarf, in the doorway. Background: her grandmother, small and bent, white hair under a brown shawl, on her three-legged stool, pointing at a woodpile, rain on the yard. Light: grey daylight, wet shine on the logs.

Close on one black wooden galoshing sole lying on a cobbler's bench, thick and cracked across the top, curls of pale wood shaving round it. Middle distance: a wooden last, a jar of pegs. Background: out of focus, a mill wheel and a snow-banked lane. Low winter sun raking across the bench. Nobody in the picture.

Foreground: one boot lifted with a black wooden galosh on it, the second galosh on the floorboards. Middle: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, and Pehr, sixty, grey, in a leather apron, the last between his knees, turning to the door. Background: yard, mill wheel, snow. Light: door-open daylight across the boards.

Foreground: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, standing still in his own yard, one pair of black wooden galoshes on his feet. Middle: a fence, hard frost on the ground. Background: the smithy across the lane with smoke off its chimney, mill wheel, snow-banked lane. Light: low cold sun, one long shadow.

Foreground: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, hands in his pockets on the far millrace bank, one pair of black wooden galoshes on his feet. Middle: the turning mill wheel, ice at the edge. Background: a snow-banked lane, three cottages, a smithy fire small. Light: sharp cold sun, ice blue.

Foreground: rain coming straight down, water sheeting off a slate doorstep; Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket soaked dark and a red knitted cap, one pair of black wooden galoshes on his feet. Middle: a shut door, a running gutter, a gate. Background: cottages, bare trees, a mill wheel. Light: flat grey rain-light, no shadows.

Foreground: a yoke across Lasse's shoulders, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, two pails swinging at its ends, one pair of black wooden galoshes on his feet. Middle: Marta, dark hair, a shawl, on a step. Background: the frozen valley end, a snow-banked lane. Light: hard sun on the ice, water swinging.

Foreground: a long table; Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, seated again in the middle of it, a pair of black wooden galoshes under the hem. Middle: an old woman beside him, guests close. Background: a hall, two windows, coats in the doorway. Light: low winter sun, one plate each.

Foreground: one pair of black wooden galoshes standing by the workshop door, the two wooden tongues lying across each other. Middle: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, peat on his back, worn boots. Background: cobbler's yard, mill wheel, autumn stubble. Light: low autumn sun, the black wood dull as a stove.

Foreground: forty pairs of good boots and fur collars crushed together on the church step, breath hanging in the air. Middle: the open church door, white light inside, people packed to it. Background: a bare lane, a low wall of snow, grey churchyard graves. Light: hard bright winter sun on frosted hats, no cloud.

Foreground: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, one hand on a brass rail round a font, one boot forward on the step. Middle: four people in his row moving along. Background: whitewashed walls, a tall window, packed benches. Light: hard white light down from the window.

Foreground: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, down on both knees on the stone flag, one pair of black wooden galoshes on his feet, the left sole cracked open. Middle: the brass rail, the font, coats above. Background: a packed congregation, a bright window. Light: hard white light on the cracked wood.

Foreground: a white-wrapped baby in his arms; Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap. Middle: Marta, dark hair, a shawl, on one side of him, a stranger on the other, three of them at the rail. Background: a packed church, a bright window. Light: hard white light from above, plain and cold.

Foreground: one pair of black wooden galoshes on the bench, left sole cracked, the two of them set down. Middle: Pehr, sixty, grey, leather apron, a wooden last between his knees, not touching it, and Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap. Background: yard, mill, snow. Light: window light on the bench.

Foreground: one pair of black wooden galoshes lying in wet gateway grass, the left tongue hanging loose, the right sprung. Middle: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, walking away in thin boots, blisters on both heels. Background: two stone gateposts, four miles of lane. Light: cold wet daylight, ice in the ruts.

Foreground: Lasse, seventeen, short fair hair, a bright green quilted jacket and red knitted cap, walking on hard ice in thin boots, breath going. Middle: a snow-banked lane, four gates in a row going off to the left. Background: a bare wood, one chimney smoke, low ice fields. Light: low winter sun down the lane, one long shadow.

Foreground: one pair of black wooden galoshes, two of them, on a loft board under a stack of leather horse collars, the left sole cracked. Middle: raft boards, harness pegs, dust in the air. Background: a small loft hatch with frost on its edges, the yard far below. Light: one shaft of daylight onto the black wood.

Foreground: the empty place on a cobbler's bench, nothing on it. Middle: Pehr, sixty, grey, in a leather apron, a wooden last between his knees, talking to a young shopman who stands listening. Background: a cobbler's yard, mill wheel, snow-banked lane, a frosted window. Light: low winter light from the window, plain and clean.
